messages:
maria: Quick design review — canary snapshot preview on the rollout timeline. Two things I noticed: timestamp clarity (UTC ISO strings are noisy) and the flip/fade motion feels heavy for some users. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/canary-snapshots (mock). Thoughts?
josh: Agree on timestamps. Seeing full ISO strings like 2026-03-23T15:04:02Z is not scannable. Proposal: compact relative for the main label (e.g. '2m ago') + full local time on hover/toolip. Also we should respect org timezone or user locale so devs in EU don't get confused.
kai: On motion — the flip + crossfade is fine visually, but we've had a few internal reports of dizziness/vestibular sensitivity. We should honor prefers-reduced-motion in CSS and add a per-user toggle in profile (defaults to OS preference).
sam: +1 to both. Small UX nit: for very recent snapshots show 'now' or 'just now' instead of '0m ago' so it's friendlier. For older ones show short date like 'Mar 23 • 15:04'.
a11y-bot: A11y note: when snapshots auto-advance with animation, screen reader users may not get an announcement. Recommend: update an offscreen live region with the snapshot label and use aria-live="polite" on the summary element. Also ensure keyboard focus doesn't move unexpectedly when snapshots swap.
kai: Minimal CSS we can drop in: ```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .snapshot-anim { animation: none !important; transform: none !important; transition: none !important; }
}
```
Add a JS fallback to disable JS-driven transforms if the user opts out.
josh: Copy suggestion: instead of 'Snapshot at 2026-03-23T15:04:02Z' use 'Snapshot — 2m ago (Mar 23, 15:04 local)'. Keeps the primary info scannable and surface the absolute time on demand.
maria: Can the scrubber snap points show exact snapshot times on hover? That would help when debugging regressions vs just eyeballing the heatmap. Tooltip should format with user locale.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: new canary snapshot created for release v1.12.0 @1732105580
sam: :thumbsup: I'll prototype the reduced-motion toggle + timestamp tooltip behavior and post a prototype link tomorrow. Will include a profile checkbox and a quick preference in the timeline settings.
maria: Thanks — assigning the prototype to Sam. Let's review in design crit on Fri. @kai @josh please ping if you have follow-ups before then.
